_note: ADDENDUM A3 NO_FIT path, step 1: occurrences only. No vocabulary in assess.py is changed. States are written as plain text here and kept apart: NO_FIT = the observed structure is known and no value in the set describes it; INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION = a value might fit but the material held cannot say which; UNRESOLVED = the record does not say why the value it carries was chosen, so fit cannot be judged from it. Survey: every claim and source in examples/*/assessment.json and the FINDINGS files, read 2026-11-15; audits/ were keyword-searched only (no hit). One cross-repository occurrence is included and marked.
